native_window (native Wayland window library) - pinned vendored copy
=====================================================================

Directory:   aae/system/3rdparty/native_window/
Source:      C:\Source2026\mp4_av_player_vs2022\shared\native_window
Commit:      c4fe282 (2026-11-02), "Add native Wayland player and reliable
             Windows/Linux audio passthrough" - the exact git-tracked files of
             shared/native_window at that commit, layout preserved, byte for byte
             (30 files, including tests/ and examples/, which AAE does not build).

DO NOT EDIT THE COPY HERE. Change the master in
mp4_av_player_vs2022/shared/native_window and re-copy the whole tree.

Why a copy and not a reference: the Flatpak build (and any CI checkout) sees only
the AAE tree, so the library has to live inside it.

Used by: aae/system/window/linux/wayland_window.cpp (WaylandWindow, the native
Wayland backend) and the EGL path in aae/system/graphics/sys_gl.cpp. Built by the
Linux branch of the top-level CMakeLists.txt when the Wayland dependencies are
present (option AAE_WAYLAND); the Windows build never sees it.
